sections.introduction:
What are varicose veins? Have you ever seen anyone who is diagnosed or suffering from this problem. There are lots of questions which come into mind. We have not even heard the name of some diseases. Due to the lack of knowledge, minor health issues result in the severe health complications. Before switching to the treatment part we must discuss the all the aspects like causes, symptoms and complications associated with the diseases. 
 ABOUT VARICOSE VEINS 
 This problem mostly occurs in the veins of thighs and legs. Abnormal thickening, twisting and bulging of veins is termed as varicose veins. 
 There are mainly two systems of veins in legs:- 

 Deep veins – which carry the most of blood back from legs to heart. 
 Superficial veins – which are present under skin and form varicose veins. 

 So these veins have one way valve that controls blood flows towards heart. But due to the failure of these valves blood flows backwards into veins which exert the excessive pressure. Due to that veins can’t close properly. This excess pressure in the veins, results in the development of the spider veins or varicose veins.

 Extended standing. 
 Urine retention by prostate also creates the strain on leg veins which results in varicose veins. 
 Overweight. 
 Any injury or surgery to legs. These conditions arrest the blood flow ways. 
 Aging.
